pages.text: The Mage Backpack provides ordinary storage plus a dedicated slot that accepts a Canister. The mounted Canister appears beneath the pack, including the visible level of its contents.$(br2)Another backpack cannot be nested inside it.

Spellcasting draws mana from the Canister installed in the equipped Mage Backpack. A full backpack without a Canister supplies no mana; a Canister elsewhere in ordinary inventory is not the active reservoir.$(br2)The next requirement is a focus: a Staff.
pages.title: Supplying a Spell
